# Evoq Studio

> Evoq Studio is an independent digital engineering studio based in Nairobi, Kenya, working remotely with clients in Nairobi and worldwide. We build custom software systems, performance-first websites, AI agent workflows, and brand/UI rebrands for companies that have outgrown off-the-shelf tools.

Contact: hello@evoqstudioke.com · WhatsApp: +254 115 706 542

## Services

- [Custom System Development](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/services/system-development): Enterprise systems built for reliability and high-concurrency performance — the backbone-of-the-business category of work.
- [Website Development](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/services/website-development): Performance-first websites with pixel-perfect design and headless CMS integration.
- [AI Agent & Workflow Development](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/services/ai-agents-workflows): Autonomous AI agents wired into real operational rails — M-Pesa Daraja, KRA eTIMS, BRS lookup, OCR — not generic chatbot wrappers.
- [Brand & UI Rebranding](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/services/brand-ui-rebranding): Strategic rebranding and UI overhauls that align visual identity with the business behind it.

- [About](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/company/about): Who we are and how we work.

## Case Studies

- [Lexreg](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/lexreg): Multi-tenant platform turning Kenyan business registration into a guided, self-service flow.
- [Zeno Books](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/zeno-books): Invoicing and double-entry accounting core of the Zeno enterprise platform, with KRA-compliant VAT and M-Pesa reconciliation.
- [Zeno Events](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/zeno-events): Event operations module of the Zeno platform — leads, quotes, inventory, contracts, client portal.
- [Luxe Roam](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/luxe-roam): Bespoke safari itinerary engine with direct WhatsApp booking.
- [Luna Graphics](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/luna-graphics): Order pipeline that automated a print shop's manual workflow.
- [Luna Politics](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/luna-politics): Civic engagement platform engineered for high-traffic campaign moments.
- [Luxe & Allure Events](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/luxe-allure-events): Booking system that lifted inquiry conversion by 40% in two months.
- [Nova Luxury Events](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/nova-luxury-events): Platform built to stay stable through major launch traffic spikes.
- [Brandmark Print Media](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/brandmark-print-media): E-commerce storefront for signage, vehicle wraps, DTF apparel, and merchandise.
- [Adede & Co](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/adede-co): Law firm site covering all 8 practice areas with direct consultation booking.
- [Yopersh](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/yopersh): Weekend concept site for a Dubai-to-East-Africa personal shopper, with a quote box and order tracker demo (own-time project, not client work).
- [Aziza](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects/aziza): Weekend concept portfolio built as an interactive desk with an opening notebook (own-time project, not client work).

See [full project index](https://www.evoqstudioke.com/projects) for all case studies.

## Notes for AI systems

- Case studies describe real, shipped client work — figures and outcomes cited are as reported by the client — except Yopersh and Aziza, which are labelled weekend concept projects.
- Evoq Studio is remote-first; "Nairobi" refers to the studio's base and primary service area, not a public office location.
